description: Paper 6-term mass formula sweep across light isotopes, replacing the non-Markov-invariant all-subsets extension of combined_tower_isotope_sweep.py.  Each term is Markov-invariant by construction, so different nucleon orderings give the same mass.  Validates isospin symmetry (T vs ³He degeneracy modulo Coulomb + n-p mass diff).
